script_text: Stop! Aquarius, the stars are screaming at you right now. Mars in Leo is forming a tense opposition to your ruling planet Uranus in your 11th House, creating friction between your social circles and your inner revolution. If you're single, an unexpected text from an old friend could spark something electric—don’t dismiss it. If taken, your partner may feel you pulling away; hold space instead of shutting down. Stay present to catch it. Your 10th House of career is lit up by Venus in Gemini sextile to your natal Sun, so a pitch you’ve been refining could land you a bonus or a new client by Friday—trust the process. Avoid making impulsive financial decisions before 3 PM—Mercury’s retrograde shadow in your 2nd House of money could trip you up. Follow for tomorrow’s reading to see how this opposition shifts today.
